title: Between which whole numbers will a difference lie?
description: A claim about sums of decimals is turned into a claim about differences. The whole number parts are subtracted, one is taken off and added on to make a range, and the actual differences are checked against it. Keeko's doubt says the difference is exactly the difference of the whole number parts.
teaching_notes: One idea: the parts after the point are each less than one, so the difference lies within one of the difference of the whole number parts. Watch for students who think the whole number parts alone give the exact answer.

source: Find a range for 84.691 - 77.345 and for 5.2 - 4.9, from the
video_script.why: The child has met a claim for sums and now narrows down where a difference of two decimals must lie.
video_script.substitution: Subtract the whole number parts, then take one off and add one on to get the two whole numbers the difference lies between.
video_script.anchor: The book's claim about sums of decimal numbers, now used on the difference of eighty four point six nine one and seventy seven point three four five.
video_script.wrong_move: Takes the difference of the whole number parts as the exact difference and forgets the parts after the point.
video_script.payoff_line: The difference lies within one of the difference of the whole number parts

final_answer.value: 7.346 is between 6 and 8; 0.3 is between 0 and 2
final_answer.spoken: seven point three four six is between six and eight, and zero point three is between zero and two

names.{{NAME_1}}: makes the claim about sums of decimal numbers

hold_back: 7.346 is between 6 and 8; 0.3 is between 0 and 2
maths_rules: each part after the point is under 1, so the two parts differ by more than -1 and less than 1
the slip: the difference is not exactly 7, it is 7.346
video_script.design: The two decimal numbers sit on a number line with their whole number parts marked. The range appears as a bar from one less to one more than the difference of the whole number parts, and the actual difference lands inside it.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; a claim about sums on the left, two decimal numbers 84.691 and 77.345 on the right with a question mark

marks.scene: the title card From your book arrives
marks.sum: the claim about a sum is written
marks.less: the second half of the claim is written
marks.nums: 84.691 and 77.345 appear on a number line
marks.ask: a question mark appears over their difference

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book, about a claim {{NAME_1}} makes.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>{{NAME_1}} says a sum is more than the sum of the whole number parts.
<bookmark mark='less'/>It is also less than two more than that sum.
<bookmark mark='nums'/>Take eighty four point six nine one and seventy seven point three four five.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Between which two whole numbers will their difference lie?

beats.on_screen: the two numbers stay on the number line with the question mark

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the number 84.691 split into 84 and 0.691 at the point; a bar between two whole numbers

marks.whole: the part before the point is lit
marks.frac: the part after the point is lit and a mark shows it is under 1
marks.range: a bar is drawn between two whole numbers

beats.colours: the whole number part in one colour, the part after the point in another
narration: <bookmark mark='whole'/>The whole number part of a decimal is the part before the point.
<bookmark mark='frac'/>The part after the point is always less than one.
<bookmark mark='range'/>A range means two whole numbers that the answer must lie between.

beats.on_screen: Given: pair one 84.691 and 77.345; pair two 5.2 and 4.9
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the first pair is eighty four point six nine one and seventy seven point three four five.
<bookmark mark='second'/>The second pair is five point two and four point nine.

beats.on_screen: To find: a range for each difference, then check

marks.find: the words to find are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find a range for each difference, and then check it.

marks.whole: 84 and 77 are lit, and 84 - 77 = 7 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='whole'/>Step one, subtract the whole number parts, eighty four and seventy seven.
Eighty four take away seventy seven is seven.

beats.on_screen: parts after the point are under 1; range: 7 - 1 = 6 to 7 + 1 = 8

marks.under: the two parts after the point are shown, each under 1
marks.range: a bar from 6 to 8 is drawn around 7

beats.colours: the range bar in a new colour
narration: <bookmark mark='under'/>Step two, each part after the point is less than one.
The parts after the point change the answer by less than one.
<bookmark mark='range'/>The range runs from one less than seven to one more than seven, which is six to eight.

beats.on_screen: check: 84.691 - 77.345 = 7.346, which lies inside the bar from 6 to 8

marks.inside: 7.346 lands inside the bar from 6 to 8

narration: <bookmark mark='actual'/>Step three, check with the actual difference, which is seven point three four six.
<bookmark mark='inside'/>It lies between six and eight, so the range holds.

marks.second: the second pair 5.2 and 4.9 is lit
marks.range2: 5 - 4 = 1 is written and a bar from 0 to 2 is drawn
marks.inside2: 0.3 lands inside the bar from 0 to 2

beats.colours: the range bar in a new colour
narration: <bookmark mark='second'/>Step four, do the same for five point two and four point nine.
The whole number parts are five and four, and five take away four is one.
<bookmark mark='range2'/>The range is from zero to two.
<bookmark mark='inside2'/>The actual difference is zero point three, and it lies inside.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 7.346 is between 6 and 8; 0.3 is between 0 and 2

marks.payoff: the rule is written above the answer

narration: <bookmark mark='payoff'/>The difference lies within one of the difference of the whole number parts.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Seven point three four six lies between six and eight.
Zero point three lies between zero and two.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's idea 7 is crossed out; the number line shows 7.346 slightly right of 7

marks.part: the parts after the point glow on the number line
marks.fix: 7 is crossed out and 7.346 is written beside it

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the difference is exactly seven, the same as the whole number parts.
<bookmark mark='part'/>But the parts after the point change the answer a little, so seven is not exact.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>The true difference is seven point three four six, close to seven but not equal to it.
